data.name: Third Time's the Charm
data.headline: First class: awkward. Second: better. Third: hooked. 3 classes for the price of 2.
data.benefit: First class: awkward. Second class: better. Third class: you're hooked. Try barre, powerCycle and Strength Lab — 3 classes for the price of 2 (₹3,885). Bengaluru: 3 barre classes for ₹2,835. Love it? Your first membership is 15% off.
data.rationale: 60.6% of first-timers never take a 2nd class. Purchase within 60 days by month-1 visits: 0 return visits 10.8%, 1 → 43.9%, 2 → 73.3%, 3–4 → 88.6%. The 2-for-1 route converts 20.8% (Bandra 17%). A third class moves people into the 73–89% band.
data.conditions: One per person (phone verified). Intro products sit outside the 25% cap as acquisition cost. Class 2 booked at the desk before leaving class 1.
data.kpi: Packs with all 3 classes used in 14 days (target 60%); pack → membership (target 35% vs 20.8% on 2-for-1).

data.name: U Up? It's 2027.
data.headline: U up? Your mat's been asking about you.
data.benefit: U up? Your mat's been asking about you. Come back this January: 15% off, and hit 12 classes this month for 5 bonus days. No awkward small talk, promise.
data.rationale: Bandra is reactivation-led (3,209 lapsed vs 5,065 renewed membership records). Renewal climbs with usage: Bandra members using <50% of sessions renew 49–58% vs 82% at 75%+. The bonus is only paid for attendance that predicts the next renewal.
data.audience: Standard lapsed 15%, bonus earned (≈20% effective if earned)
data.conditions: Standard lapsed 15%, bonus earned (≈20% effective if earned). No stacking with the spot sale.
data.kpi: Lapsed buyers; share hitting 12 classes (target 40%); Feb renewal of Jan winbacks.

data.name: Same Time Next Week
data.headline: Your pack is nearly out. Same one again, 15% less.
data.benefit: You're nearly out of classes. Take the same pack again at 15% off — ₹7,229 for ten at Copper + Cloves, ₹5,891 for eight — and we’ll add a week of validity so none of them go to waste.
data.rationale: The pop-ups sell class packs, not memberships, so renewal is a repurchase decision rather than an expiry date. Four of the twelve months carried a renewal target with no renewal offer in the catalogue; this is the standing one.
data.audience: Pop-up clients whose class pack is running out.
data.conditions: 15% off the pack, inside the cap. One per client per pack expiry. The extra week of validity has no cash value.
data.kpi: Packs repurchased within 14 days of running out (target 55%); share of pop-up renewal revenue with an offer behind it.
